formal.source:
∀  (ctx : CardanoLedgerApi.V3.ScriptContext),
  (match ctx.scriptContextScriptInfo with
    | .SpendingScript _ _ => True
    | .MintingScript _ => False
    | .RewardingScript _ => False
    | .CertifyingScript _ _ => False
    | .VotingScript _ => False
    | .ProposingScript _ _ => False) ∨
  PlutusCore.UPLC.Utils.isUnsuccessful («spendingOnly»  (CardanoLedgerApi.IsData.Class.toLedgerData ctx))

statement.text: The compiled script rejects every purpose outside {spend}.

      (match ctx.scriptContextScriptInfo with | .SpendingScript _ _ => True | _ => False) →
      isSuccessful (spendingOnly (toLedgerData ctx))
